Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. As we scope the CloudMosaic <> Redwood integration for marketplace distribution, we put together a short preflight checklist so both teams are aligned on technical gating, certification, and contract milestones. Attached is the checklist (cloudmosaic-preflight-checklist.xlsx). High level asks: 

- Sandbox & staging: need a dedicated sandbox environment with dataset seeding and KV cache persistence for 14 days.
- Telemetry: a telemetry schema (event names + required fields) so we can map usage to our billing. We attached a proposed schema as telemetry-schema.yaml.
- Entitlements: marketplace entitlement header (X-Partner-Entitlement) and token exchange guidance for Marketplace listing.
- Compliance: confirmation of SOC 2 evidence and data retention policy for logs (30/90 day options).
- Contract: mutual action plan + proposed milestone dates (we prefer to sign by 6/30 to align with our partner launch).

Could you route these to the right product, security and legal owners? We also have a few non-functional asks around kernel compatibility and Quantized model support for 8-bit weights.

Thanks — happy to hop on a working session; Evan and I are flexible next week.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of ISV Partnerships
CloudMosaic Inc

On Mon, Jun 11, 2028 at 10:05 AM hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai wrote:
> Product asks I captured that may require short work:
> 1) Add optional header X-Partner-Entitlement to our auth proxy and document request/403 behavior. (small infra change)
> 2) Expose a feature-flag to maintain KV cache across restarts for partner sandboxes (configurable TTL).
> 3) Add an opt-in telemetry hook to emit partner_id and deployment_tag (non-PII) for marketplace usage attribution.

Quick feasibility from product/runtime side:
- X-Partner-Entitlement header: feasible. We need a one-week engineering task to add header parsing + entitlement check in the gateway and a short docs update. No model changes.
- KV cache persistence flag: medium effort. We have a caching persistence switch in our runtime but it isn't configurable per-deployment. To enable per-partner TTL we need ~3 sprints (6 weeks) to make it safe for multi-tenant hosted infra. As an alternative we can offer a dedicated sandbox pool pinned to a small set of machines; that would be faster (2 weeks) but require reservation by infra.
- Telemetry hook: Marcus will confirm schema compatibility, but we can add partner_id and deployment_tag as optional fields in streaming telemetry with a 2-week work window.

On quantization / kernel compatibility: our inference runtime supports 8-bit quantization profiles but depends on the model family. Marcus — can you validate the specific model they plan to ship? If it's an LLaMA-variant we should be OK; if it's a heavily-customized transformer we may need a compatibility pass.

Proposed path:
1) Short-term (2 weeks): reserve a pinned sandbox pool, add X-Partner-Entitlement header in 1 week, validate telemetry mapping.
2) Medium-term (6 weeks): implement per-deployment KV persistence TTL behind a feature-flag and extend docs.

I'll volunteer product to own the sandbox reservation plan and the header doc.

-Jonas
Director, Product
